title: Chainalysis says hackers stole credentials and tokens for all of its customers
summary: Company said a "multifront cyberattack" included AI agents and an on-path data snatch.
llm_summary: Chainalysis disclosed that it was hit by a coordinated “multifront” cyber‑attack in which hackers managed to steal authentication credentials and crypto‑wallet tokens belonging to every one of its customers.
